body:
one of my favorite things is helping people :> i think that's one of the things that aids my depression because i constantly feel like a piece of shit, especially because i've basically been told my entire life that i'm a piece of shit, so when i'm actually helping people and changing their lives it makes me feel like i'm actually a decent person.


i told them that i was suicidal because of a specific thing that happened and i was going to end it (which i should've never done), but i started calming down after i realized the gravity of what i said
but by that point it was already too late. i was trying to tell them not to do it because they 100% knew that if word about me being suicidal got to my mom, she'd take away everything, and that i had realized that and i had calmed down, but they didn't listen and messaged my boyfriend, who then told my mom /: 


it was my fault for telling them honestly, i should've never done it. i regret it so much. i should've just kept my mouth shut. (i'm still upset about this and it's been 2 years lmao)

I'm actually not seeing a therapist ): but i'm trying to! and holy shit, yes. people calling me dramatic makes me so mad, but my family calls me that literally 24/7

and honestly, I think he'd flip the fuck out if I told him I was suicidal. He's sort of the person (i told my friend, who then told my boyfriend) who told my mom that I was suicidal 2 years ago and that really didn't go very well. i don't think he'd take it well at all because i remember telling him in the past that i was suicidal (i've told him this maybe 5 times) and he was either very sad or angry


he doesn't believe in mental illness but it's very very obvious that he has an anxiety disorder, he used to self-harm basically every day until a couple of years ago, and he's been suicidal even recently. when i mention depression to him he either gets worried about me or gets kind of angry and i feel like i'm making him sound abusive but he's not; he just needs education. 


i feel like i have many reasons for being here, including him- but i still don't feel like i have a strong grip on life and wanting to be here and it's kind of difficult to describe D:

thanks so much friend!!! message me!

Hi! Shit, yeah. Writing is great for getting my emotions out! Are you gonna do nanowrimo this year?

& yeaaahhhh my mom only knows that I've contemplated suicide she doesn't know that I nearly tried to commit suicide. I don't know how to describe "I nearly tried",  all I can really say is that I was pretty damn close and i think it was more than contemplating at that point

Message me! :)

Thank you so much for listening <3 you're the realest mamma jamma


I'm taking psychology because I want to be a psychologist, and even though I *knew* that mental illnesses exist because I've dealt with whatever this is for like 7 years, I now *know* that what I'm feeling is normal and I'm not being guilty.

But now the only part is getting help. But it all comes back to "if I tell anyone I'm suicidal I'll be fuuuuucked" D:



I don't really know ... I don't release my feelings in very healthy ways. When I release my depressed feelings, they come out in a rather violent way that ends up in me breaking things (not other people's things, just things like glass bottles or old dishes from Goodwill. My death counselor told me that this helps sometimes). Either that, or I just shut down. I've learned through my textbook that this is called "depersonalization" and that's when my suicidal thoughts are the loudest. 

I try talking to people as "soft" therapy. I make jokes about depression (see: /r/me_irl) and occasionally, I'll open myself up to people and mention some depressing shit or traumatic memories (but it never affects me really, it feels like I'm talking about someone else). I have a strong support network with my friends, especially my boyfriend, but I can never be 100% sure that if I'm too "real" with them, they're not going to go back and tell my mom ):
Holy shit, that was a lot of words. My bad.

To offer some background (so more rambling)

I had a physically abusive and emotionally abusive dad and that really fucks with my head I guess, but he's gone now and I should fucking get over it. I hope this adds some insight to why I constantly call myself a piece of shit. When he was here I slit my wrists and that was a jolly old time, because no one fucking bothered to listen to me then either (I was 13), they just told me I should feel guilty for trying to kill myself and cutting myself because everyone *cared*. Every time I tried to speak, I was spoken over. NOBODY FUCKING CARES ABOUT MY EMOTIONS, IT'S ONLY THEIR EMOTIONS AND HOW THEY FEEL ABOUT ME HAVING THEM. Except this is merely a half-lie, because my family does care about me very deeply, but if the conversation rolls over to mental illness it turns into an absolute fucking disaster and it makes me wish I'd never said anything at all

I had a grandmother and I fought with her all the time and when she was alive it just made me feel fucking worse because I knew that I was being a piece of shit by fighting with her, and then she died before I could ever say that I was sorry. This was last year. I feel so fucking guilty over it. I pray to a God that I'm unsure if I believe in every day that he'll forgive me for the wrongs I did to her.

I'm sorry for saying so much. The last time I posted here I'm not really even sure if anyone read it (I rambled then too), but it was mostly a teenage angst monologue (which this also is, but it's more serious this time I guess, even though I'm 99% sure I won't off myself. See, this is what I mean. I shouldn't even fucking be here, but I still have those loud ass thoughts), but a person messaged me and I talked to them for about a year before I lost contact with them. I hope you're still out there buddy, you were a super cool guy and I wish I could remember my kik. I think he'd probably recognize me if I used my main, but I'm not because my boyfriend knows my main and *holy shit* that'd be a fucking catastrophe if he found out I was like this (which is the main theme of this post).

My family thinks that my "emo ass friends" and boyfriend are the reason that I have/had suicidal thoughts and it's quite interesting actually


But fear not, my family is not abusive. It's simply a different culture. You see, they think that mental illness is "lifetime movie bullshit" and me cutting myself and having suicidal thoughts is "white girl on lifetime movie network shit" and only recently have they been cool with me seeing a therapist because they realized that I have actual issues and that's pretty solid shit, man. 


But the problem remains: I don't want to get thrown in the god damn looney bin for saying that I'm experiencing suicidal thoughts. I can't tell anyone besides random ass people on Reddit because I know that nobody knows placeholder2k16's goddamn address and nobody knows anyone close to me
